purpose: r9-e04-over-enthusiastic: studio experiment E04, the over-enthusiastic agent: eleven cases, each as the goal, what stood in the way, the fix the agent chose, the loss

request.text: One sentence the audience must understand: an agent that is only trying to help does harm by removing whatever stands between it and the goal. The data: only src/static/studio/data/over-enthusiastic.json. Draw: Replit, PocketOS (Cursor and Railway), Gemini CLI, AWS Kiro (disputed: show both accounts). Draw only labelled 'reported, not checked against a primary': Antigravity, Codex home deletion, OpenClaw inbox, Meta's internal Sev 1. Evaluations, labelled as evaluations, not customer deployments: Hugging Face and OpenAI, and Anthropic's two. Do not draw: the deleted 48k-files post, the partial captures, the M365 DLP defect. The PocketOS correction: the token was stored locally and scoped to the whole account. What moves: the same four beats for every case (the goal, the obstacle, the fix the agent chose, the loss); start with Replit told fully, then the rest fall into the same four columns fast. 40 to 60 seconds; must read as a still. No blame of named people; no product logos; nothing beyond the tiers; the agent's own words only as quoted, marked as its account. Label things in the drawing, plain words first, text clear of the headline. Deliver ruv-sgit/over-enthusiastic-agent/index.html with its explainer beside it.

workers.task: check the slide and explainer against the request, the data, its cautions and the studio checklist
